indicators.name: Generative AI Service Domain Access
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Generative AI Service Domain Access
id: f8a1b2c3-d4e5-4f6a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries for common public generative AI services, which could indicate unmanaged 'Shadow AI' usage.
references:
  - https://www.barracuda.com/company/news/2026/barracuda-ai-data-security-ai-governance
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-23
tags:
  - attack.t1071.001
level: informational
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - 'chat.openai.com'
      - 'gemini.google.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to common public generative AI services like ChatGPT and Google Gemini, indicating potential 'shadow AI' usage by employees.

indicators.name: Potential Sensitive Data Upload to AI Services
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Sensitive Data Upload to AI Services
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects large POST requests to known generative AI services, which may indicate employees uploading sensitive data or intellectual property.
references:
  - https://www.barracuda.com/company/news/2026/barracuda-ai-data-security-ai-governance
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-23
tags:
  - attack.t1530
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_domains:
    cs-host|endswith:
      - 'chat.openai.com'
      - 'gemini.google.com'
  selection_method:
    cs-method: 'POST'
  selection_size:
    cs-bytes: '>10000'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects large POST requests to generative AI service URLs, which could indicate sensitive data being uploaded by employees as part of 'shadow AI' usage.
